title: 50/30/20 Rule
when_to_use: Someone has no budget yet or wants a simple way to split income between needs, wants, and savings.
how_it_works: Put 50% of after-tax income toward needs like rent and groceries, 30% toward wants like dining and shopping, and 20% toward savings or debt.

title: Sinking Funds
when_to_use: Someone gets surprised by large irregular expenses, or is saving toward a goal with a deadline.
how_it_works: Divide the target amount by the number of months until it's due, and set that amount aside every month in a separate account or category.
